ValidationRule.description: Mailing Postcode Block field is mandatory if Nationality equals Bahrain
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Bahrain"), ISBLANK(Mailing_Postcode_Block__c), OR( RecordTypeId='0121t000000IVAF', RecordTypeId='0121t000000IVAG' ), NOT(ISBLANK(Mailing_City__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the customer's mailing Postcode/Block to proceed
